tools.name: repl
tools.description: Run JavaScript in a sandbox whose only API is the `computer` global, which reads and controls native apps on this computer. There is no file system, network, shell, or browser. Variables persist between calls. Start with `await computer.getApp('<app name>')`; it prints the app's state and the full usage guide.
